bounds.affine_h_tests.note: Affine H/Xi tests are INCLUDED in filter H/Xi, not additional evaluations.

bounds.affine_xi_tests.note: Affine H/Xi tests are INCLUDED in filter H/Xi, not additional evaluations.

filter.all_lane_predicate_tests.note: Distinct comparisons, but not a time-weighted CPU total.
filter.all_lane_predicate_tests.operation: admission lane tests + exclusion lane tests

filter.xi_hmin_positive.note: An Xi evaluation may serve BOTH exclusion and admission; never count it twice.
filter.xi_hmin_positive.operation: all Xi evaluations - Xi on Hmin<=0

local28.navigation_frames.note: Joined's old edge.node_visits are predicate subsets of those traversals and are NOT added. Summary child reads remain separately reported.
local28.navigation_frames.operation: Individual/Live: spatial node visits + seed query visits; Joined: antichain visits + product visits; both add actually prepared live-summary node visits

local28.seed_cell_geometry_tests.note: Block quadratic bounds and singleton linear bounds have different costs; no time-equivalence asserted.
local28.seed_cell_geometry_tests.operation: old line tests + new block bounds + new singleton bounds, only stages actually executed

local28.total_edge_peak_bytes.note: Coupled per-edge capacity peak, including atlas preparation; not RSS or worker-sum.

memory.worker_edge_peak_sum.note: Sum of per-worker maxima, not simultaneous peak, not RSS. Can vary with scheduling.

q3.all_prepared_bounds.note: Includes prepared-unvisited child bounds; do not add that subset again.
